CustomField.description: When you select this box, all new starts park (issue #136). In-flight instances continue. This is not the definition pause. Clear the box, and the next watchdog sweep sends the parked starts to the gate. The watchdog records each change in Workflow_Log__c. Default: off.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Parks all new starts. In-flight instances continue.
CustomField.label: Emergency Stop
